# Grounded Copilot

> A retrieval-augmented copilot that answers only from its sources, with inline citations, an abstention guardrail when retrieval is weak, and a faithfulness check that verifies every claim traces back to a cited passage.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot

## Source

- [src/grounded_copilot/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/__init__.py): Grounded Copilot - retrieval-augmented answers with citations and faithfulness.
- [src/grounded_copilot/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/cli.py): Command line interface for the grounded copilot.
- [src/grounded_copilot/compose.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/compose.py): The offline answer composer used by the fake provider.
- [src/grounded_copilot/copilot.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/copilot.py): The copilot pipeline: retrieve, abstain or answer, cite, and check faithfulness.
- [src/grounded_copilot/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/data.py): A small knowledge base of passages and a labeled question benchmark.
- [src/grounded_copilot/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/evaluation.py): Evaluation: abstention accuracy, faithfulness, and citation coverage.
- [src/grounded_copilot/faithfulness.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/faithfulness.py): Faithfulness checking: does every answer sentence trace to a cited source? An answer is faithful when each of its claims is supported by a passage it cites.
- [src/grounded_copilot/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/grounded_copilot/provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/provider.py): The language-model provider interface, a deterministic fake, and a real client.
- [src/grounded_copilot/retrieval.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/retrieval.py): A from-scratch TF-IDF retriever over a corpus of text chunks.
- [src/grounded_copilot/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/grounded-copilot/blob/main/src/grounded_copilot/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the grounded copilot.
